paite: Asik in atapa Jehoshaphat alal a, Israel mite dou ding in akihihhat hi.
heading: Kumpipa In Jehoshaphat Apang

paite: Huchi in Judah gam a kulh nei khopi tengteng ah sepaih akoih a; Judah gam leh apa Asa in ana lak Ephraim gam a khuate ah galvilmi akoih hi.
Huan Jehoshaphat kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; Baal zong lou a, apu David in atot masaksa lampi tawn a,
apipute uh Pathian zong a, Israel mite hih bang hih lou a, athupiakte azuih zawk ziak in.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N akhut ah agam ahihkip a, huchi in Judah gammi tengteng in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, ahong hau in athupi hiaihiai hi.
TOUPA lam ah alungsim a-awn a, Judah gam a kipan mun sangte leh Asherahte aphiatmang vek hi.
Kum thum avaihawm kum in amilian Benhail, Obadiah, Zekariah, Nathanael, Mikaiah, Judah gam khuate a mite sinsak ding in asawlkhia a;
Levi mi, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, Tobadonijah atel tei ua, siampu Elishama leh Jehoramte leng atel uhi.
TOUPA Dan Bu atawi ua, Judah gam ah asinsak ua, Judah gam khua tengteng tawn in mite asinsak uhi.
Huchi in Judah gam leh akim gam tengteng a mite'n TOUPA laudan asiam ua, kuamah in Jehoshaphat adou ngam kei uhi.
heading: Jehoshaphat Thupina

paite: Philistia mi khenkhat in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, siah ding in dangkasik leng ape lai uh; Arabia mite'n ganhon, belamtal sangsagih-le-zasagih leh keltal sangsagih-le-zasagih ahon kai uhi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat ahong thupi mahmah a, Judah gam ah kulhte leh thil koihkhawmna khuate abawl a, Judah gam khuate ah nasep tampi anei hi.
Jerusalem ah sepaih mihat hangsante ahau behlap lai hi.
A-inkuankuan ua a-omdan uh hichibang ahi: Judah inkuan a sangkhat heutute, heutu Adnah in mihat hangsan nuaithum aheu hi.
Azom Jehohanan in nuainih-le-singgiat aheu hi.
Azom nawn Zikri tapa Amasiah bel kiphaltak a TOUPA a ding a kipia in, mihat hangsan nuainih aheu hi.
Benjamin inkuante mihat hangsan Eliada in thal leh lum zangmi nuainih aheu hi.
Azom Jehozabad in galkap ding a mansiangsa nuaikhat- le-singgiat aheu hi.
Hiai tengteng Judah gam a kulh nei khopi a kumpipa'n akoihte sim louh akumpipa kiang a om gigete ahi uh.
